releases.summary: Fix obsolete missing posters, keep render state responsive, and simplify Queue / Preview
notes: Includes the 0.5.45 fix: obsolete missing posters do not trigger Locate Media; missing active media still stops export with REVIEW.
Generate and approval wait for Text/Style saves and Page selection; failed saves and stale window revisions block unreviewed rendering.
Persisted response revisions and own queue/audio revision chains avoid false other-window REVIEW; edits during final refresh block generation until saved.
Patch/QC run outside the main state lock with single-worker ownership checks. Atomic JSON writes preserve last-good state.
Revision-aware schedule cache and gzip; bounded preview workers publish complete files atomically and clean only regenerable caches.
Desktop Queue and Preview sit together; output and Style settings open on demand; Audio and mobile-header overflow fixed.
Update package reduced from 205 MB to 90 MB while retaining FFmpeg/FFprobe executables, licenses and provenance.
237 regression tests passed. Live Premiere 26.0.2 / UXP 0.5.47 rendered WED12 MXF with Technical QC and local publish passed.
Human audible/on-air acceptance and Premiere 25 / team workstations have not been revalidated. Database migration remains paused.
